name: cip-monorepo
description: Polyglot monorepo for CIP, the open protocol for governed agent operations: spec, schemas, SDKs, reference adapters, and conformance tools.

scripts.build:ts: npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/cip && npm run build --workspace @new-odyssey/cip-conformance
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
scripts.test:ts: npm run test --workspace @new-odyssey/cip && npm run test --workspace @new-odyssey/cip-conformance
